notes.title: New version1.6 arrival - buy zombies in the battle
notes.notes:
Many people complain about the difficulty of the game curve is too high, or zombies supply too little.

Some players buy and unlock all skills, and they told me that the gold useless.

So version 1.6 Improved it -- you can buy zombies in the battle.

The Pack Store will open every 5 levels, there are 3 purchase options, including zombies and level up items. Of cause it also depends on whether you unlock them.

The purchase price will increase with difficulty, but I believe you will buy them.

In addition, I modified the background music, but this does not make much senseːsteammockingː

notes.title: 3/6 bug fixed
notes.notes:
[*]Modify the problem of screen horizontal screen in some flat panel Windows system
 [*]Repair the bug at start game , the store UI is not completely disappear before when you use keyboard to cancel it.
 [*]Improved zombie bounce when too close to the wall, being squeezed out of the screen, but not completely eradicated
 [*]Modify the value of the error caused by the enemy level is too large, the current difficulty adjustment is moderate
 [*]Resolved the bomber to kill the enemy while generating an infected zombie, resulting in the end of the turn to refresh the zombie.

Thank you for you play and all your feedbacks , I will try to repair Bugs and strive to add more fun content.
